theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+0.52%) and Consumer Staples (+0.02%) led the market today, while Materials (-1.81%) and Technology (-0.92%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.16%, defensives -0.37%, and value/cyclicals -0.83% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.41%, Dow -0.53%, Nasdaq -0.40% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.71%. The VIX rose 4.62% to 17.22, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.98% to $4,408.20, crude oil was little changed at $100.47, and bitcoin slipped 1.40% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
